DeggKrea2StyleReference.description: Builds a CONDITIONING from a reference image through the Krea2/Qwen3-VL vision path. It does not patch the diffusion model and does not inject latent tokens: the reference is described semantically, so use it for text-to-image with Krea2.

clip.name: CLIP
clip.tooltip: Text encoder loaded with type krea2 (Qwen3-VL). The node calls clip.tokenize(..., images=[...]) so the reference reaches the vision path.

style_image.name: Style image
style_image.tooltip: Reference image used ONLY for style: palette, materials, brushwork, light and overall visual language. The depicted subject is not copied unless the prompt asks for it.

prompt.name: Prompt
prompt.tooltip: Describe the image you want. The reference already speaks for style, so describe the subject and the scene instead of repeating the reference.

style_strength.name: Style strength
style_strength.tooltip: How assertively the reference should steer the result. This is wording, not a sampler value: light is conservative, strong is assertive.

vision_resolution.name: Vision resolution, px
vision_resolution.tooltip: The reference is scaled to roughly this many pixels per side before it reaches Qwen3-VL. 384 is stable, 512 keeps more detail but costs more time.

custom_instruction.name: Custom style instruction
custom_instruction.tooltip: Optional. Leave empty to use the strength preset. When filled it replaces the preset instruction; the target prompt is still appended.

0.name: conditioning
0.tooltip: Positive conditioning with the reference described by Krea2/Qwen3-VL.

DeggKrea2StyleFusion.description: Adds the target image as a VAE-encoded starting latent on top of the semantic style conditioning. With a low KSampler denoise the subject and composition stay, while the style of the reference image is transferred.

clip.name: CLIP
clip.tooltip: Text encoder loaded with type krea2 (Qwen3-VL). Only the style reference image enters clip.tokenize(..., images=[...]).

vae.name: VAE
vae.tooltip: Krea2/Qwen image VAE. It encodes the target image into the starting latent for KSampler.

style_image.name: Style image
style_image.tooltip: Reference image used ONLY for style: palette, materials, brushwork, light and overall visual language. It enters the Qwen3-VL vision path.

target_image.name: Target image
target_image.tooltip: Image that supplies subject, pose and composition. It is encoded by the VAE into the starting latent and never enters the CLIP image path.

prompt.name: Prompt
prompt.tooltip: Describe the image you want. Describe the target subject and result; do not repeat the reference image subject.

style_strength.name: Style strength
style_strength.tooltip: How assertively the reference should steer the result. This is wording, not a sampler value; how much structure survives is set by KSampler denoise.

vision_resolution.name: Vision resolution, px
vision_resolution.tooltip: The style reference is scaled to roughly this many pixels per side before it reaches Qwen3-VL. 384 is stable, 512 keeps more detail but costs more time.

custom_instruction.name: Custom style instruction
custom_instruction.tooltip: Optional. Leave empty to use the strength preset. When filled it replaces the preset instruction; the target prompt is still appended.

0.name: conditioning
0.tooltip: Positive conditioning with the reference described by Krea2/Qwen3-VL.

1.name: latent
1.tooltip: Starting latent made from the target image; feed it to KSampler.latent_image.
